question_2_granularity.answer: BOTH, split by instrument class. Subject granularity for account-class - the accepting subject is the natural person who holds the account. The answer is genuinely both, and the two are not alternatives applied to the same instrument: no instrument is accepted at two granularities. Each instrument has exactly one accepting principal.

question_3_versioning.answer: A version identifier plus an immutable content identity, both bound into every acceptance row (decision 4), and a reacceptance trigger that is EXPLICIT rather than inferred from version ordering (decision 5).
question_3_versioning.the_non_obvious_half: Decision 5 is the substantive part. Under a naive model, publishing any later version invalidates every prior acceptance. Decision 5 forbids that: a later version invalidates prior acceptances ONLY where it is explicitly marked reaccept_required. This changes the currency predicate from a comparison against the latest version into a search for an intervening reaccept_required marking, and REACCEPTANCE below states the predicate in the only fail-closed-correct form.

DELTA_1A_SUBJECT.the_difference: R1 binds FIVE elements where canonical HPO-A.4 names FOUR. The fifth is the accepting subject or actor.
DELTA_1A_SUBJECT.grounds: HPO-A.1 makes account-class acceptance account-level, which presupposes an account holder. HPO-A.3 names organization_admin as the accepting role for the organization-class act. An acceptance recording no actor could satisfy neither clause. R1 made the entailment explicit in the evidence tuple; canonical leaves it in the granularity clauses.
DELTA_1A_SUBJECT.drift_verdict: NO SEMANTIC DRIFT. No correction required, and the element remains in REQUIRED_ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE_FLOOR.
DELTA_1A_SUBJECT.R2_COMBINED_BLOCK_SUPERSEDED: R2 recorded both elements under one key DELTA_1_SUBJECT_AND_RETAINED_TEXT with a single NO_DRIFT_ON_OWNER_INTENT classification. That combined block is SPLIT at R3 because the two elements have opposite dispositions. The R2 text is preserved verbatim at DRIFT_COMPARISON.DELTA_1_R2_COMBINED_SUPERSEDED for audit comparison.

DELTA_1B_RETAINED_TEXT_OR_BYTES.the_difference: R1 read content identity as requiring the retained TEXT and not only a digest, and R2 confirmed that reading as a DERIVED requirement that STANDS.
DELTA_1B_RETAINED_TEXT_OR_BYTES.R2_DISPOSITION_WITHDRAWN: R2 recorded this under a single combined heading with the subject element and concluded NO_DRIFT_ON_OWNER_INTENT over both together. That combined conclusion is WITHDRAWN. Labelling the reading DERIVED_NOT_GRANTED was correct as far as it went, but the artifact then enforced it anyway — as a constraint on content_identity, as a NOT NULL column in T2, and as invariant I-T2-4. A requirement that is labelled derived and then enforced is still a requirement.
DELTA_1B_RETAINED_TEXT_OR_BYTES.why_the_two_had_to_be_split: They have OPPOSITE dispositions. The subject element is entailed by canonical clauses and is binding. The retention element is not entailed by anything canonical and is not binding. Reporting them under one NO_DRIFT conclusion let the second inherit the standing of the first, which is precisely how an unratified requirement acquires the appearance of owner backing.
DELTA_1B_RETAINED_TEXT_OR_BYTES.drift_verdict: THIS WAS A REAL OVER-REQUIREMENT AND IS CORRECTED IN R3. It did not misstate owner intent in words — the DERIVED label was present — but it enforced beyond owner intent in structure, which has the same effect on any implementation measured against this authority.

DELTA_2_MUTATING_VERB.the_difference: Canonical HPO-A statement reads must occur via POST (or another proper mutating verb). R1 wrote must mutate by POST, never render-time GET and pinned POST exclusively throughout INVITATIONS.
DELTA_2_MUTATING_VERB.direction: R1 IS NARROWER THAN CANONICAL. R1 forbids nothing canonical permits at the level of safety — every verb R1 allows, canonical allows — but R1 would REFUSE an implementation canonical explicitly permits, for example a PUT or DELETE handler.
DELTA_2_MUTATING_VERB.why_it_matters_even_though_it_is_the_saf: An authority that is stricter than its owner ratification is still wrong, in a specific and costly way: it converts a permitted implementation choice into an apparent authority violation, and a future implementer who chose PUT would be told to change working code to satisfy a constraint the owner never set. Over-narrowing also hides which part of the rule is load-bearing. The load-bearing property is PROPER MUTATING VERB, NOT RENDER-TIME GET; POST is the expected instance of it, not the rule.
DELTA_2_MUTATING_VERB.R2_CORRECTION: APPLIED. INVITATIONS.R2_CORRECTION_MUTATING_VERB restates the requirement as canonical does, and the companion manifest control is re-scoped to assert the property rather than the literal verb.

ZERO_SEMANTIC_DRIFT_ASSERTION.requirement: Zero semantic drift between the R1 transcription and the resident canonical HPO-A.
ZERO_SEMANTIC_DRIFT_ASSERTION.recomputed_at_R3: Nine clause comparisons. SEVEN identical. THREE recorded differences across two clauses: DELTA_1A (subject — ENTAILED, no drift), DELTA_1B (retained bytes — OVER-REQUIREMENT, corrected at R3), DELTA_2 (mutating verb — OVER-NARROWING, corrected at R2 in prose and materialized in the normative text at R3).
ZERO_SEMANTIC_DRIFT_ASSERTION.status_after_R3_corrections: SATISFIED. The assertion holds for the artifact AS OF R3, and only because two over-reaches were corrected — one at R2 and one at R3.
ZERO_SEMANTIC_DRIFT_ASSERTION.honesty_note: R1 did not transcribe HPO-A with zero drift. R2 corrected one of its two over-reaches and, by grouping the other with an entailed element, let it survive. R3 corrects the second. The assertion is a statement about the artifact after three revisions, never a claim that any single revision got it right.
ZERO_SEMANTIC_DRIFT_ASSERTION.what_would_falsify_this: A canonical HPO-A clause that this artifact enforces more strictly than the clause states, or more loosely. The two found so far were both STRICTER, which is the direction that looks safe and is therefore the direction an auditor must check deliberately.

DELTA_1_R2_COMBINED_SUPERSEDED.why: Its single NO_DRIFT conclusion let the retention over-requirement inherit the standing of the entailed subject element.
DELTA_1_R2_COMBINED_SUPERSEDED.the_difference: R1 binds FIVE elements; canonical HPO-A.4 names FOUR. R1 adds subject, and R1 reads content identity as requiring the retained TEXT and not only a digest.
DELTA_1_R2_COMBINED_SUPERSEDED.disposition_of_subject: ENTAILED, NOT INVENTED. The subject is fixed by HPO-A.1 and HPO-A.3 together: A.1 makes the acceptance account-level, which presupposes an account holder, and A.3 names the accepting role for the organization-level act. An acceptance that did not record WHO accepted could not satisfy either clause. R1 made the entailment explicit in the evidence tuple; canonical leaves it in the granularity clauses. NO SEMANTIC DRIFT. No correction required.
DELTA_1_R2_COMBINED_SUPERSEDED.disposition_of_retained_text: ALREADY SELF-LABELLED BY R1 AND NOW CHECKABLE. R1 INSTRUMENT_MODEL.content_identity carries DERIVED_NOT_GRANTED: true and states in terms that it reads decision 4 as requiring the identity AND retaining the text, recording that as an interpretation rather than a grant. Comparison against canonical CONFIRMS the labelling was correct: HPO-A.4 says content hash and does not require retention. The interpretation therefore stands as a DERIVED design requirement with its grounds stated, and an auditor may challenge it without challenging owner intent.
DELTA_1_R2_COMBINED_SUPERSEDED.why_the_interpretation_is_retained_rathe: A digest alone lets you PROVE a candidate document matches; it does not let you PRODUCE the document. For an instrument whose purpose is to be shown to a person later, that difference is the whole point. Relaxing it would be a defensible alternative and is recorded as such; it is not required by canonical text in either direction.
DELTA_1_R2_COMBINED_SUPERSEDED.classification: NO_DRIFT_ON_OWNER_INTENT. One entailed addition, one correctly-labelled derivation.

RAT_AO_CONSUMPTION.status: BINDING. Three owner micro-ratifications consumed from integration.
RAT_AO_CONSUMPTION.source: docs/ops/commercial/COMMERCIAL_V1_MICRO_RATIFICATIONS_v1.0.0.json, resident in current live f0d81d1d via PR146 (exact object 1cddd310). Read from integration, NOT from the PR branch. PR146 is NOT modified by this revision.
RAT_AO_CONSUMPTION.source_authority_class: PRODUCT_ALIGNMENT_REFERENCE_NOT_EXECUTABLE_AUTHORITY. These settle PRODUCT INTENT and grant no executable authority.
RAT_AO_CONSUMPTION.relationship_to_HPO_A: The three are REFINEMENTS of HPO-A, not replacements. RAT-AO-01 and RAT-AO-02 refine HPO-A.3 (the accepting role) by fixing what happens to everyone who is NOT that role. RAT-AO-03 refines HPO-A.5 (the reacceptance trigger) by adding the time dimension the canonical word GOVERNED left open.

RAT_AO_01.statement_verbatim: A member who is not organization_admin, whose organization still lacks current commercial acceptance, cannot satisfy or bypass that obligation themselves. They receive a non-sensitive blocked state. The organization_admin receives the completion call-to-action instead.

FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO1_C1_NON_ADMIN_CANNOT_SATISFY: A member whose role is not organization_admin CANNOT satisfy the organization commercial acceptance obligation. The L1 write is refused for them.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO1_C2_NON_ADMIN_CANNOT_BYPASS: That member also cannot BYPASS the obligation. They do not get product access in lieu of acceptance. Refusing to let them accept is not the same as letting them through, and both halves are binding.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO1_C3_NON_SENSITIVE_BLOCKED_STATE: The non-admin receives a NON-SENSITIVE blocked state: enough to explain that access is pending, and no more. The canonical binding_semantics says the blocked state does not disclose sensitive acceptance detail beyond what is needed to explain that access is pending.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO1_C4_ADMIN_GETS_THE_CTA: ONLY organization_admin receives the completion call-to-action — the affordance that lets the obligation actually be satisfied.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO1_C5_NO_ELEVATED_NON_ADMIN_BYPASS: There is NO viewer, reviewer, analyst or impact_manager bypass for this blocking cause. Role elevation short of organization_admin does not lift the block.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO1_C6_NO_HIERARCHY_PREDICATE: The accepting role MUST NOT be broadened by a hierarchy predicate. See THE_EXACT_ROLE_PREDICATE — this is the clause with the sharpest implementation consequence.

THE_FOUR_NAMED_ROLES_ARE_EXHAUSTIVE_OVER.claim: RAT-AO-01 names viewer, reviewer, analyst and impact_manager, and those FOUR are the complete set of tenant roles that are neither the accepting role nor platform-adjacent. The enumeration has no gap.
THE_FOUR_NAMED_ROLES_ARE_EXHAUSTIVE_OVER.measured: lib/auth/roles.ts:13-19 declares SIX role values: super_admin, organization_admin, impact_manager, analyst, reviewer, viewer. db/schema.ts:113 constrains organization_members.role to the SAME six via check('role_check', role IN ('super_admin','organization_admin','impact_manager','analyst','reviewer','viewer')).
THE_FOUR_NAMED_ROLES_ARE_EXHAUSTIVE_OVER.the_partition: 6 = 1 accepting role (organization_admin, AO1_C4) + 4 named non-admin roles (AO1_C5) + 1 platform-adjacent value (super_admin, governed by RAT-AO-02 and the platform-admin boundary). CLOSED WORLD, no residue.
THE_FOUR_NAMED_ROLES_ARE_EXHAUSTIVE_OVER.why_this_matters: A control asserting no bypass for four named roles could otherwise be satisfied while a fifth role slipped through. There is no fifth. The closed world is a measured property of the role enum, not an assumption, and a control may therefore assert refusal across the COMPLETE non-admin set.

THE_EXACT_ROLE_PREDICATE.status: THE CENTRAL IMPLEMENTATION CONSEQUENCE OF RAT-AO-01, AND A NEW FINDING OF THIS REVISION. Recorded as F-AO-18.
THE_EXACT_ROLE_PREDICATE.requirement: The L1 accepting-role predicate MUST be EXACT EQUALITY on organization_admin, over an ACTIVE membership in the affected organization. It MUST NOT be a hierarchy threshold, and its role set MUST NOT contain super_admin.
measured_why: lib/auth/permissions.ts:24-26 defines hasRole(userRole, requiredRole) as ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] >= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole] — a RANGE predicate.
lib/auth/roles.ts:38-44 assigns super_admin 100 and organization_admin 80. Therefore hasRole('super_admin','organization_admin') evaluates 100 >= 80 = TRUE.
db/schema.ts:113 permits super_admin as an organization_members.role VALUE. So a membership row can carry role super_admin, and a range predicate would admit it as an accepting principal.

CONSEQUENCE: an L1 check written in the ambient idiom — hasRole(role,'organization_admin'), exactly the shape canManageUsers uses at lib/auth/permissions.ts:33-35 — WOULD ADMIT a tenant super_admin, which RAT-AO-02 forbids. The ratification would be violated by code that looks idiomatic and passes review.

THE_AMBIENT_CONVENTION_PRODUCES_THE_WRON.measured: hasRole( is INVOKED at 17 sites inside lib/auth/permissions.ts (18 lines MATCH the token; one of them is the definition at :24) and at 60 sites repo-wide across lib/, app/ and components/ in 21 files, excluding tests and the definition. Separately, BOTH role-set literals in permissions.ts — STELLA_ROLES and REVIEW_ROLES — INCLUDE super_admin (2 of 2).
THE_AMBIENT_CONVENTION_PRODUCES_THE_WRON.the_structural_fact: Every existing authorization predicate in this codebase either uses a hierarchy threshold or uses a role set whose FIRST element is super_admin. L1 accepting-role predicate must be the FIRST predicate in this codebase that does NEITHER.
THE_AMBIENT_CONVENTION_PRODUCES_THE_WRON.why_it_is_worth_stating_as_a_finding: This is not a warning about carelessness. An implementer following the established local convention faithfully will produce a predicate that violates RAT-AO-02, because the convention itself encodes an assumption — platform principals are always at least as authorized — that RAT-AO-02 reverses for this one act. Novelty against a consistent local pattern is exactly the condition under which a mutation control is required rather than optional.

THE_REPOSITORY_ALREADY_HAS_THE_RIGHT_IDI.measured: lib/auth/permissions.ts:109-115 and :164-166 both state, in the repository own words, SET INCLUSION, not a hierarchy threshold, and explain that reviewer ranks below analyst in ROLE_HIERARCHY yet is the dedicated reviewing role, so it is checked by explicit membership.
THE_REPOSITORY_ALREADY_HAS_THE_RIGHT_IDI.consequence: The discipline RAT-AO-01 requires is a CARRIED convention, not an invention by this artifact. L1 extends it one step further: a SINGLETON set that, uniquely, excludes super_admin.

THE_EXACT_ROLE_PREDICATE.corroborated_by_a_sibling_ratification: RAT-OP-01, in the same canonical file, independently reaches the identical conclusion for a different decision: role EXACTLY organization_admin, with hasRole('>=') / role-hierarchy / '+' notation and implicit admission of tenant super_admin all excluded. Two owner ratifications converging on the same predicate shape over two different acts is strong evidence the shape is the intent and not a drafting artifact.

WHAT_RAT_AO_01_DOES_NOT_AUTHORIZE: No specific UI copy, route or component — canonical explicit_non_authorizations says so in terms, and this artifact designs none.
No platform-admin or support override — canonical points at RAT-AO-02.
No acceptance record schema or storage decision — that remains this artifact FUTURE_DDL, which is conceptual only.
NO AUTOMATIC NOTIFICATION. Canonical says the organization_admin RECEIVES the completion CTA. It does NOT say the system sends anything. See A3_REMEDY_RESOLUTION.WHAT_REMAINS_UNRATIFIED.

RAT_AO_02.statement_verbatim: Commercial V1 has NO platform-admin, support, or commercial-team mechanism that unilaterally records application legal/commercial acceptance on behalf of an organization. Application commercial acceptance is performed only by an active organization_admin. Manual commercial activation under HPO-B does not substitute for legal or commercial acceptance.

FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO2_C1_NO_UNILATERAL_PLATFORM_RECORDING: No platform-admin, support or commercial-team actor may record an organization application legal or commercial acceptance on that organization behalf.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO2_C2_ONLY_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION_ADMIN: Application commercial acceptance is performed ONLY by an ACTIVE organization_admin of the affected organization. The word ACTIVE is part of the clause: a suspended, removed or pending membership does not qualify.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO2_C3_HPO_B_IS_ORTHOGONAL: Manual commercial activation performed under HPO-B is a DISTINCT operational action and does NOT substitute for, or satisfy, legal or commercial acceptance.

THE_POSITIVE_CLAUSE_DOES_THE_WORK.observation: The mission prompt enumerates five categories — platform-admin, support, operator, commercial-team, manual back-office. The canonical statement enumerates three — platform-admin, support, commercial-team.
THE_POSITIVE_CLAUSE_DOES_THE_WORK.adjudication: NO CONFLICT, and no new enumeration is invented here. AO2_C2 is a POSITIVE CLOSED CLAUSE: acceptance is performed ONLY by an active organization_admin. A positive-only clause excludes every actor who is not that, whether or not the actor is named in the negative list. The negative enumeration is ILLUSTRATIVE of the categories the owner had in mind; the positive clause is EXHAUSTIVE by construction.
THE_POSITIVE_CLAUSE_DOES_THE_WORK.consequence: An operator, a back-office tool, a migration script, a cron job and a support macro are excluded by AO2_C2 whenever they lack an active organization_admin membership in the affected organization — which is the ordinary case and the one the clause is aimed at. The test AO2_C2 applies is MEMBERSHIP AND ROLE, not principal kind. See SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PRECISION_R3 for the correction of the over-broad R2 formulation, which claimed a service principal is excluded as such.
THE_POSITIVE_CLAUSE_DOES_THE_WORK.why_this_reasoning_is_recorded_rather_th: Relying on a positive clause to exclude unnamed actors is exactly the kind of inference an auditor should be able to check. Stating it makes it challengeable. If the owner intended the negative list to be exhaustive and some unnamed actor to be permitted, that is a different ratification and this reading would be wrong.
THE_POSITIVE_CLAUSE_DOES_THE_WORK.R2_CONSEQUENCE_SUPERSEDED_AT_R3: An operator, a back-office tool, a migration script, a cron job, a support macro and a service principal are all excluded by AO2_C2 without needing to appear in any list. This is the stronger reading and it is also the one that cannot be defeated by inventing a category nobody enumerated.

ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE_IS_NOT_ACCEPTANCE.the_prohibition: ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE, and any other manual commercial activation state, MUST NOT be treated as acceptance evidence and MUST NOT bypass L0 or L1.
ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE_IS_NOT_ACCEPTANCE.provenance_of_the_state_name_measured: ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE is ratified vocabulary from HPO-B.7 — ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE only via explicit manual activation — in the same canonical HPO_A_G file. It is NOT this artifact invention and NOT a term borrowed from code.
ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE_IS_NOT_ACCEPTANCE.materialization_state_measured: The state DOES NOT EXIST in the repository. grep for ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE across db/ and lib/ returns ZERO matches, and commercial_accounts.commercial_status is constrained by commercial_status_check to exactly ('active','past_due','suspended','closed') — see db/schema.ts:32.
ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE_IS_NOT_ACCEPTANCE.therefore: The conflation RAT-AO-02 forbids is a FORWARD prohibition on a state that does not exist yet, not the correction of a present defect. Stating it that way matters: an auditor must not read this clause as evidence that a bypass exists today, and an implementer must not read the state absence as permission to skip the constraint when the state lands.
ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE_IS_NOT_ACCEPTANCE.the_shape_of_the_error_being_prevented: Two facts about an organization will exist side by side — it is commercially active, and it has not accepted. The convenient move is to treat the first as implying the second, because an operator manually activated it and presumably knew what they were doing. That inference converts an OPERATIONAL decision into LEGAL EVIDENCE, and the operator who made it was never the organization authorized representative.

WHAT_RAT_AO_02_DOES_NOT_AUTHORIZE: Building any platform-admin acceptance-recording tool, now or as a future convenience — canonical explicit_non_authorizations says exactly this.
Altering HPO-B scope beyond clarifying that it is not an acceptance substitute.

Any change to the measured super-admin membership-check exception at db/identity-context.ts:217. That remains MO-07 REQUIRED_RESOLUTION and needs its own authority. RAT-AO-02 prevents the acceptance model from DEPENDING on it, which is what X-AO-06 already prohibited in R1 and what RAT-AO-02 now raises from a derived prohibition to a ratified one.

R1_X_AO_06_IS_NOW_RATIFIED_NOT_MERELY_DE.before: R1 SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.X-AO-06 forbade the super-admin membership-check exception becoming an acceptance-writing capability, and R1 derived that prohibition from ACCEPTANCE_MODEL.WHO_MAY_WRITE_AN_ACCEPTANCE plus ratification MO-07.
R1_X_AO_06_IS_NOW_RATIFIED_NOT_MERELY_DE.after: RAT-AO-02 AO2_C1 states it as owner policy directly. X-AO-06 is UPGRADED from DERIVED to RATIFIED. Its text is unchanged; its standing is stronger, and a future mission may no longer argue it away as an over-cautious derivation.

SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PRECISION_R3.R2_CLAIM_WITHDRAWN: R2 stated that an operator, a back-office tool, a migration script, a cron job, a support macro and a SERVICE PRINCIPAL are all excluded by AO2_C2 without needing to appear in any list. The inclusion of SERVICE PRINCIPAL in that list is WITHDRAWN as over-broad.
SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PRECISION_R3.what_AO2_C2_actually_requires: That the accepting actor hold an ACTIVE membership in the affected organization with role EXACTLY organization_admin. That is a MEMBERSHIP-AND-ROLE test. It is not a test of what KIND of principal the actor is.
SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PRECISION_R3.the_precision: RAT-AO-02 does NOT independently impose a NATURAL PERSON requirement. RAT-OP-01 imposes one — natural_person_authorizer_only — but it does so for SUPPORT-CAPABILITY ISSUANCE, a different act, and its requirement does not transfer to acceptance merely because the two ratifications share a role predicate.
SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PRECISION_R3.consequence_correctly_stated: A service principal that holds no active organization_admin membership in the affected organization is excluded — like any other actor failing the test. But a service principal that SOMEHOW HOLDS a valid active organization_admin membership would SATISFY AO2_C2 on its face. RAT-AO-02 alone does not exclude it.
what_still_holds_unchanged: Every actor WITHOUT an active organization_admin membership in the affected organization is excluded — platform-admin, support, operator, commercial-team, back-office tooling, cron, migration script. That part of the R2 reading is correct and is retained.
No assisted acceptance path is created by this correction, and none is authorized. RAT-AO-02 explicit_non_authorizations forbids building any platform-side acceptance-recording tool.
No service-principal acceptance authorization is created. This correction states what the ratification does and does not exclude; it grants nothing.
SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PRECISION_R3.where_the_real_protection_lives: The question the correction exposes — how a principal that should not hold organization_admin comes to hold it — is MEMBERSHIP PROVENANCE, and it is external to this authority. It is recorded as F-AO-23 and, at R3, as the now-measured U-AO-8. Acceptance authority is exactly as trustworthy as membership assignment, and this artifact states that dependency rather than concealing it behind a principal-kind claim it cannot support.
SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PRECISION_R3.why_the_over_broad_claim_was_attractive: Adding service principal to the excluded list made the boundary look airtight without needing the membership-provenance dependency. That is precisely why it had to go: it substituted a comfortable claim for an honest one.

RAT_AO_03.statement_verbatim: There is no universal reacceptance grace period. Each legal-instrument version may carry a governed effective_at. Before effective_at the product may inform the user. From effective_at onward, if that version's reaccept_required flag is true, a prior acceptance no longer satisfies the gate until the new version is accepted. Legal sufficiency, notice requirements, and timing remain counsel-required, and this ratification does not decide which locale/language is legally controlling.

FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO3_C1_NO_UNIVERSAL_GRACE_PERIOD: No blanket grace period after a version effective_at applies across all versions or all organizations. There is no grace duration to configure and none to invent.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO3_C2_PER_VERSION_EFFECTIVE_AT: Each legal-instrument version MAY carry its own governed effective_at timestamp. MAY, not MUST — a version without one is not thereby invalid, and the currency predicate must handle its absence.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO3_C3_PRE_EFFECTIVE_NOTICE_IS_PERMITTED: Before effective_at the product MAY inform the user of the upcoming version, and is NOT REQUIRED to block on it. Notice is a permission, not an obligation, and it is not a gate.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO3_C4_POST_EFFECTIVE_GATE: From effective_at onward, when reaccept_required is true for that version, any prior acceptance of an earlier version STOPS satisfying the gate until the new version is accepted.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO3_C5_COUNSEL_BOUNDARY_PRESERVED: Legal sufficiency of notice, the specific notice requirements, and their timing remain COUNSEL_REQUIRED and are NOT decided by this ratification.
FROZEN_CLAUSES.AO3_C6_LOCALE_UNDECIDED: This ratification does NOT decide which locale or language text is legally controlling. Canonical states explicitly that the question, tracked as LRF-02, remains COUNSEL_REQUIRED, and carries lrf_02_status: COUNSEL_REQUIRED as a field.

NO_GRACE_DURATION_IS_INVENTED.requirement: AO3_C1 forbids a universal grace period and no number is supplied. This artifact invents none.
NO_GRACE_DURATION_IS_INVENTED.what_replaces_the_idea_of_a_grace_period: effective_at does the work a grace period was reaching for, and does it per version rather than globally. The interval between publication and effective_at IS the notice window, it is set by the publisher per version, and during it the gate does not refuse. That is structurally different from a grace period, which is an interval AFTER the gate should have closed during which it is held open.
NO_GRACE_DURATION_IS_INVENTED.the_distinction_that_must_not_be_collaps: A pre-effective window is the gate NOT YET APPLYING. A grace period is the gate APPLYING AND BEING IGNORED. The first is a property of the version; the second is a bypass. RAT-AO-03 grants the first and forbids the second, and an implementation that models the second as the first has built the bypass under a permitted name.

resolved: F-AO-05 — the A3 remedy question. RESOLVED by RAT-AO-01 to exactly two states. See A3_REMEDY_RESOLUTION.

GATE_NAMING.rule: This artifact introduces exactly TWO new gates and names them in the vocabulary the existing frozen contracts already use, so that the combined evaluation order can be stated as one ordered list rather than three unrelated ones.
GATE_NAMING.L0: ACCOUNT_LEGAL_ACCEPTANCE gate. Predicate: every account-class instrument is currently accepted by this subject.
GATE_NAMING.L1: ORGANIZATION_COMMERCIAL_ACCEPTANCE gate. Predicate: every organization-class instrument is currently accepted for the organization in the request scope.
GATE_NAMING.why_not_one_gate: They have different accepting principals (subject vs organization), different roles (any subject vs organization_admin), and - decisively - they sit on OPPOSITE SIDES of the tenancy question. Collapsing them into one gate would force the combined gate to ask a tenancy question for a subject who has not selected an organization yet, which is precisely what B0 and L0 must not do.

L0_IS_A_PREFIX_L1_IS_A_SUFFIX.claim: L0 is structurally a prefix in the same sense Packet B calls B0 a prefix. L1 is structurally a suffix. This is the single most important result of this section and it is DERIVED, not chosen.
L0_IS_A_PREFIX_L1_IS_A_SUFFIX.derivation_L0_prefix: L0 asks no tenancy question. It needs no organization, reads no carrier, and enumerates no memberships - the same three properties Packet B B0_VERIFICATION_PRECEDES_TENANCY relies on to justify placing B0 before R1. Placing L0 after R1..R5 would mean a subject who has accepted nothing is routed through enumeration and selection first, which discloses tenancy shape to a subject who has not yet met an account-level precondition. Placing L0 before R1 returns control to R1..R5 untouched once the predicate passes.
L0_IS_A_PREFIX_L1_IS_A_SUFFIX.derivation_L1_suffix: L1 is organization-scoped by HPO-A decision 2. Its predicate names an organization. Before Packet A has resolved a scope there IS NO organization to name, so L1 is not merely better placed after R1..R5 - it is UNDEFINED before them. This is also why FAIL_CLOSED case 5 (no organization selected) is answered by Packet A unchanged and NOT by L1.
L0_IS_A_PREFIX_L1_IS_A_SUFFIX.consequence_for_preservation: The two gates therefore need DIFFERENT preservation arguments. L0 preserves Packet A the way B0 does - by being a prefix that returns control untouched. L1 cannot affect Packet A routing at all, because it is only reachable once Packet A has already produced a destination. See PACKET_A_PRESERVATION.

WHY_B0_PRECEDES_L0.status: DERIVED FROM FROZEN AUTHORITY, NOT CHOSEN BY THIS LANE.
grounds: Packet B PRE_VERIFICATION_WRITE_EXCEPTION.WHAT_IT_MUST_NOT_BE_ABLE_TO_CREATE enumerates seven things a pre-verification write must not create, and the list includes, verbatim, any commercial acceptance record. Frozen Packet B authority therefore ALREADY forbids writing an acceptance record before verification. L0 placed before B0 would require exactly that write.

The substantive reason, which that prohibition encodes: an acceptance is evidence that a particular person assented. Before B0 the platform has not established that the subject controls the address the account is keyed to, so an acceptance captured then is an assertion by an unproven party. It is worse than no evidence, because it looks like evidence.
Packet B PRE_VERIFICATION_WRITE_EXCEPTION.status reads FROZEN, NARROW, AND THE ONLY ONE, and its sole exception is syncUserProfile. L0 is not that exception and may not become a second one.
WHY_B0_PRECEDES_L0.consequence: If a future mission proposes capturing acceptance at signup - a checkbox on the registration form, for example - that proposal contradicts frozen Packet B authority and is a fail-closed STOP, not a UX preference. See SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.X-AO-01.

WHY_L0_PRECEDES_BOOTSTRAP.status: DERIVED FROM HPO-A DECISION 1 PLUS THE JOURNEY ORDER.
grounds: Decision 1 places account acceptance before PRODUCT ACCESS. Founding an organization is a product effect: it creates tenant rows, a membership, an audit trail and a commercial relationship. It is not a pre-product act.

LC0 own rationale for gating self_service_onboarding harder than assisted activation is that self-service removes the negotiated-contract path that could otherwise carry acceptance out of band. Founding IS the self-service path. Acceptance must precede it or the gate has no effect where LC0 says it binds hardest.
The invited-member journey never founds anything, yet decision 1 still applies to that subject. Only a gate placed BEFORE the founding branch covers both journeys with one predicate.
WHY_L0_PRECEDES_BOOTSTRAP.what_this_forbids: Capturing account acceptance INSIDE the bootstrap transaction. That would make acceptance a byproduct of a form submit, would leave every invited member unaccepted, and would put a per-subject record inside a per-organization transaction. See ATOMICITY_BOUNDARIES.AB-2.excluded.

grounds: Decision 2 makes commercial acceptance organization-level. An organization must exist to be the accepting principal, so L1 cannot precede the transaction that creates it.

Decision 3 makes organization_admin the accepting role. The founder acquires that role INSIDE the bootstrap transaction - measured at app/(authenticated)/app/onboarding/actions.ts:138, role written as the constant ROLES.ORGANIZATION_ADMIN. Before that transaction commits there is no organization_admin to accept.
Therefore the ordering is not a preference: L1 depends on two facts that only exist after AB-2 commits.

THE_WINDOW_THIS_CREATES.description: An organization exists, has a founder who is organization_admin, has a CommercialAccount association, and has NO commercial acceptance. This state is REAL, LEGITIMATE and UNAVOIDABLE - it is forced by decision 2 making the two acceptances separate.
THE_WINDOW_THIS_CREATES.must_not_be_engineered_away: A future implementation must NOT close this window by folding L1 into the bootstrap transaction. Doing so would (a) contradict decision 2 separateness, (b) make acceptance a byproduct of founding rather than a discrete act, and (c) be impossible for any organization whose administrator later changes or whose instrument later requires reacceptance - both of which reopen the window anyway. The window must be HANDLED, not eliminated.
THE_WINDOW_THIS_CREATES.how_it_is_handled: L1 refuses, and the refusal is actionable by the subject standing in front of it - the founder, who IS the organization_admin. See FAIL_CLOSED.FC-1 and NO_DEADLOCK_PROOF.

NO_DEADLOCK_PROOF.why_it_is_needed: L1 gates entitlement; entitlement gates product capability; discharging L1 requires organization_admin. If acquiring organization_admin itself required an entitled capability, the graph would deadlock and no organization could ever be activated.
NO_DEADLOCK_PROOF.proof_founder_path: The founder acquires ROLES.ORGANIZATION_ADMIN inside AB-2 itself, measured at app/(authenticated)/app/onboarding/actions.ts:138, with the role written as a CONSTANT and never taken as a parameter. Acquiring it therefore consumes no entitlement and passes through no L1. The founder emerges from AB-2 already holding the role that discharges L1. No cycle.
NO_DEADLOCK_PROOF.proof_invited_path: An invited member never needs to discharge L1 at all - see JOURNEY_INVITED_MEMBER. Their journey contains no L1 obligation, so no cycle can form through it.
NO_DEADLOCK_PROOF.the_one_residual_cycle_risk: If a future implementation makes the ACT OF INVITING an entitled capability, then an organization that has not discharged L1 cannot invite, which is correct and is not a deadlock - the founder can still discharge L1 themselves. But if it ALSO made discharging L1 require a capability, the cycle would form. SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.X-AO-04 forbids that second step by name.

ADJUDICATION_FOUNDER_VS_INVITED.instruction_discharged: The mission requires this adjudication explicitly and requires it WITHOUT inventing new owner policy. Each clause below therefore names either the HPO-A decision that grants it or the frozen authority it is derived from.

A1_ACCOUNT_ACCEPTANCE_IS_IDENTICAL_ON_BO.ruling: Both journeys require L0 from the subject personally, at the same position, with the same predicate.
A1_ACCOUNT_ACCEPTANCE_IS_IDENTICAL_ON_BO.grounds: HPO-A decision 1 - account-level, and an account belongs to one natural person. There is no clause in HPO-A permitting an administrator to accept account-class instruments on another subject behalf, and this artifact does not create one.
A1_ACCOUNT_ACCEPTANCE_IS_IDENTICAL_ON_BO.consequence: An organization_admin cannot pre-accept Terms or Privacy for the people they invite. An invitation therefore cannot deliver a ready-to-use account; it delivers a membership to a subject who must still pass L0 themselves.

A2_COMMERCIAL_ACCEPTANCE_IS_ASKED_OF_THE.ruling: An invited member is NEVER PROMPTED for commercial acceptance, regardless of the role they are invited into - unless that role is organization_admin AND the organization L1 is undischarged, in which case they are a permissible discharger, not a required one.
grounds: HPO-A decision 3 names organization_admin as THE organizational accepting role. A viewer or an ordinary member does not hold it and therefore cannot discharge L1 - asking them would be asking for an act they cannot perform.

HPO-A decision 2 makes the acceptance ORGANIZATION-level, which means once per organization, not once per member. A second member accepting the same instrument version for the same organization adds no new fact.
A2_COMMERCIAL_ACCEPTANCE_IS_ASKED_OF_THE.the_precise_shape: L1 is a property of the ORGANIZATION, satisfied or not. It is never a per-member checklist item. Any implementation that stores a commercial acceptance per member has misread decision 2.

A3_AN_INVITED_MEMBER_IS_STILL_AFFECTED_B.ruling: A member of an organization whose L1 is undischarged has no entitled product capability in that organization, because entitlement is downstream of L1 in the journey and is organization-scoped.
grounds: The supplied journey places organization commercial acceptance strictly before entitlement/bootstrap eligibility, and before product.

Ratification CA-04 - entitlements are evaluated at the organization/product-capability boundary - and CA-08 - usage is metered and enforced per Organization. Entitlement is a property of the organization, so a member inherits their organization entitlement state; they do not carry a personal one.
A3_AN_INVITED_MEMBER_IS_STILL_AFFECTED_B.DERIVED_NOT_GRANTED: This is a derivation from the journey order plus CA-04/CA-08, not a clause of HPO-A. It is recorded as derived so that a future auditor can challenge the derivation rather than mistake it for owner policy.

WHAT_IS_NOT_ADJUDICATED_HERE.the_open_question: WHAT THE BLOCKED MEMBER IS TOLD, and whether the administrator is notified. A member blocked by their administrator inaction is a real product outcome with a real support cost, and the remedy - the wording, whether the member sees the reason, whether the admin is emailed - is UX and product policy that HPO-A does not address.
WHAT_IS_NOT_ADJUDICATED_HERE.disposition: STOP_FOR_HPO on the REMEDY ONLY. The GATE is derived and stands; the user-facing treatment of the refusal is an owner decision. Recorded as OPEN_FINDINGS.F-AO-05.
WHAT_IS_NOT_ADJUDICATED_HERE.why_the_gate_does_not_wait_for_it: A gate whose refusal wording is undecided still refuses correctly. Deferring the gate until its copy is written would leave the stage gate open, which is the failure LC0 is guarding against. Fail closed with a generic refusal beats fail open with good copy.

A4_THE_INVITATION_ITSELF_IS_NOT_AN_ACCEP.ruling: Accepting an invitation is not accepting any legal instrument, and db/schema.ts:148 invitations.acceptedAt is not acceptance evidence.
A4_THE_INVITATION_ITSELF_IS_NOT_AN_ACCEP.grounds: HPO-A decision 4 requires an acceptance to bind instrument_key, version, content identity, subject and accepted_at. invitations.acceptedAt carries none of the first three. Reusing it would produce evidence that names no document.

A5_ROLE_CHANGE_DOES_NOT_RETROACTIVELY_CR.ruling: An acceptance record is evidence of a past act. If the subject who discharged L1 later loses organization_admin, or leaves the organization, the acceptance remains valid and is NOT re-required.
A5_ROLE_CHANGE_DOES_NOT_RETROACTIVELY_CR.grounds: Derived from HPO-A decision 4, which binds the acceptance to a subject and an accepted_at - i.e. to a moment. Nothing in HPO-A conditions continued validity on continued role tenure, and reacceptance is triggered ONLY by decision 5 mechanism.
A5_ROLE_CHANGE_DOES_NOT_RETROACTIVELY_CR.what_must_be_recorded_for_this_to_be_aud: The acceptance row must record the role the accepting subject held AT ACCEPT TIME, because that role is the authority for the act and is not reconstructible from current membership state. See FUTURE_DDL.T4.accepted_by_role.

INSTRUMENT_MODEL.purpose: HPO-A decision 4 requires an acceptance to bind an immutable text or content identity. Nothing in the repository can supply one today. This section defines what an instrument of record IS, so that an acceptance names a document that can be reconstructed years later.

INSTRUMENT_OF_RECORD_VERSUS_PRESENTATION.ruling: An instrument of record is a VERSIONED, IMMUTABLE, CONTENT-ADDRESSED artifact. The pages at app/(public)/terms, /terminos, /privacy and /privacidad are PRESENTATION of an instrument and are never the instrument itself.
INSTRUMENT_OF_RECORD_VERSUS_PRESENTATION.why_the_separation_is_mandatory_and_not_: A React Server Component renders differently as a function of the component tree, the build, the runtime locale and any dependency it pulls in. Its rendered text is not a stable artifact and carries no version. An acceptance recorded against it would name a document whose content at accept time is unrecoverable - which is the specific failure HTF-11 significance describes: there is no queryable answer to which instrument version any user or organization accepted.
INSTRUMENT_OF_RECORD_VERSUS_PRESENTATION.prohibition: A content identity MUST NOT be computed by rendering a page, hashing a component file, or hashing a build output at acceptance time. See SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.X-AO-03.
INSTRUMENT_OF_RECORD_VERSUS_PRESENTATION.what_the_presentation_surfaces_must_do_i: Render FROM the instrument of record, and display the version they are rendering. This artifact does not design that UI and allocates no work for it; it fixes the direction of the dependency - presentation reads the record, never the reverse.

instrument_key.definition: A stable, human-meaningful, immutable identifier for the CONTINUING instrument across all its versions - for example the concept Terms of Service, not any one edition of it.
constraints: Never reused for a different instrument.
instrument_key.closed_set_at_this_artifact: The set of instrument_key values is CLOSED to what HPO-A decision 1 and decision 2 name: account-class Terms, account-class Privacy, organization-class commercial. The literal string values are NOT pinned here - naming them is a future allocation - but the CARDINALITY and the class assignment are.

instrument_class.meaning: ACCOUNT-class instruments are accepted by a subject and gate L0. ORGANIZATION-class instruments are accepted for an organization by an organization_admin and gate L1.
instrument_class.constraint: The class is a property of the instrument_key, fixed at first publication, and MUST NOT vary by version. An instrument that changed class between versions would move the gate a subject must pass mid-journey.
instrument_class.closed_world: Exactly two classes. A third class requires new owner policy - see HPO_LC0_04_DISCHARGE.question_1_which_instruments.closed_world_status.

version.definition: An identifier for one published edition of an instrument_key, totally ordered within that key.
constraints: A published version is NEVER edited. A correction is a NEW version.
The ordering must be a genuine total order, because REACCEPTANCE searches an interval of it.
version.explicitly_not_decided: Whether versions are integers, dates, or semver strings. Any total order satisfies the contract. Pinning the format here would be an implementation choice masquerading as authority.

content_identity.definition: A cryptographic digest over the EXACT bytes of the instrument text as published, together with the algorithm that produced it.
REQUIRED_constraints: The digest is computed over the published bytes at publication time and is IMMUTABLE thereafter. The row is append-only.
The digest algorithm MUST be recorded alongside the digest, not assumed, so that a future algorithm change does not silently reinterpret old rows.

R3_CORRECTION.what_R1_and_R2_got_wrong: R1 defined content identity as the digest PLUS the stored bytes or an immutable reference, and made storing them together a CONSTRAINT. R2 then described that reading as a DERIVED design requirement that STANDS. Between them they elevated durable retention of the instrument text to a binding element of the model — visible in this key's former definition and constraint list, in FUTURE_DDL.T2 where content_bytes was NOT NULL, and in I-T2-4.
R3_CORRECTION.why_it_was_wrong: Canonical HPO-A.4 reads: Acceptance binds instrument identity, version, content hash, and timestamp. It requires a HASH. It does not require that the hashed bytes remain retrievable, and no other HPO-A clause or RAT-AO adds that requirement. An authority that makes retention mandatory REJECTS a conforming implementation that keeps only the canonical digest evidence — which is a constraint the owner never set.
R3_CORRECTION.the_correction: Durable retention of instrument bytes, or of an immutable reference to them, is an IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE. It is RECOMMENDED and it is NOT REQUIRED. It is explicitly NOT an ENTAILED_INVARIANT, NOT an OWNER_RATIFIED_REQUIREMENT, and NOT part of REQUIRED_ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE.
R3_CORRECTION.conformance_rule: An implementation that retains ONLY instrument identity, version, content digest (with its algorithm) and timestamp — plus the accepting subject or actor where the acceptance act structurally requires one — is FULLY CONFORMANT to this authority and MUST NOT be rejected by it, by its companion manifest, or by any exit gate derived from either.

WHY_RETENTION_IS_STILL_RECOMMENDED.the_practical_argument: A digest alone lets you PROVE that a candidate document is the one that was accepted; it does not let you PRODUCE that document. If the bytes are lost, the acceptance record still proves an act occurred against a specific content identity, but the content itself must be reconstructed from some other source or is gone.
WHY_RETENTION_IS_STILL_RECOMMENDED.why_that_argument_does_NOT_make_it_manda: Whether the platform must be able to reproduce the instrument text — and for how long — is a legal, privacy and retention question, not an engineering one. It sits with LRF-01 (what evidence is sufficient) and LRF-04 (retention versus erasure), both COUNSEL_REQUIRED and both unresolved. This authority must not pre-empt either by making retention a structural requirement, and it must not pre-empt them in the other direction either.
WHY_RETENTION_IS_STILL_RECOMMENDED.no_duration_chosen: This artifact selects NO retention duration, NO storage medium and NO reproduction obligation. Those are for whichever authority answers LRF-01 and LRF-04.

content_identity.derivation_scope_note: The DERIVED_NOT_GRANTED label now attaches to the RECOMMENDATION only. The required floor — identity, version, digest with algorithm, timestamp, and the structurally required actor — is canonical, not derived.

locale.measured_problem: Terms exists at app/(public)/terms/page.tsx (182 lines) and app/(public)/terminos/page.tsx (173 lines); Privacy at /privacy (164) and /privacidad (155). Nothing declares which is canonical or asserts they are translations of one binding text.
locale.why_this_artifact_does_not_decide_it: Which language of an instrument binds a signer is a legal question, not an engineering one, and HPO-A does not address it. Deciding it here would be exactly the invention of owner policy the mission forbids.
locale.what_is_decided: The DDL MUST carry a locale on the version row so that the choice is not foreclosed by the schema, and the acceptance MUST bind the specific localized version the subject was shown. That is decidable now and is fail-closed under either eventual answer: binding the shown text is correct whether or not another locale is also authoritative.

reaccept_required.definition: An explicit boolean on a VERSION, declaring that publishing this version invalidates acceptances of all earlier versions of the same instrument_key.
constraints: NOT NULL and NO DEFAULT. The publisher must state it.
Immutable once published, because acceptances have already been evaluated against it. Flipping it retroactively would silently revoke or restore currency for subjects who acted on the prior value.
reaccept_required.why_no_default: A defaulting flag masks omission, and the fail-open default (false) is the dangerous one: an instrument published with a genuine reacceptance obligation would silently keep every stale acceptance current. Packet B X-B-03 already forbids the optional-with-a-true-default shape for the same class of reason, and R3_ADDITION_THE_PRESERVATION_PROOF_HAS_A_PREREQUISITE states it directly - a defaulting flag would mask exactly this class of omission. That reasoning is CARRIED here, not reinvented.
reaccept_required.the_fail_closed_direction_is_not_obvious: For this flag, neither default is safe in both directions, which is why the answer is no default at all rather than a safe default. Defaulting false under-triggers reacceptance; defaulting true over-triggers it and would force the entire user base to reaccept on any typo correction. Requiring an explicit value is the only option that cannot be wrong by omission.

PUBLICATION_IS_A_GOVERNED_ACT.ruling: Publishing an instrument version is a privileged, audited act, not a deploy artifact.
PUBLICATION_IS_A_GOVERNED_ACT.grounds: A version row carries reaccept_required, which can invalidate every existing acceptance in the system. That is a blast radius comparable to a permission change and must not be reachable by a code deploy or by an ordinary tenant role.
constraints: The publisher must be a platform-level principal. This artifact does NOT name which one, because platform-admin identity is governed by the platform-roles lineage and Packet B section 6 forbids redesigning it from an adjacent lane.
Publication writes an audit row in the same transaction as the version row.
Publication of a version with reaccept_required true is the single highest-impact operation this model defines and must be independently confirmable from audit alone.
PUBLICATION_IS_A_GOVERNED_ACT.NOT_DECIDED_HERE: Whether publication is a UI, a governed migration, or an operator runbook. All three satisfy the constraints. See OPEN_FINDINGS.F-AO-06.

R2_VOCABULARY_ALIGNMENT_EFFECTIVE_AT.change: R1 named the version timestamp effective_from. The ratified vocabulary is effective_at (RAT-AO-03 AO3_C2, and the canonical binding_semantics key per_version_effective_at). This artifact ALIGNS to effective_at throughout.
R2_VOCABULARY_ALIGNMENT_EFFECTIVE_AT.why_a_rename_matters_in_an_authority: R1 declared its object and column names to be descriptive placeholders, so the rename costs nothing structurally. But a ratified term used with a different spelling invites exactly the drift this revision exists to remove: a future reader comparing artifact to ratification would have to decide whether two names mean one thing. They do, and the artifact now says so in the ratified spelling.
R2_VOCABULARY_ALIGNMENT_EFFECTIVE_AT.scope: FUTURE_DDL.T2 conceptual column, and every reference in REACCEPTANCE_R2. No other clause depended on the name.

R2_EFFECTIVE_AT_SEMANTICS.definition: The governed timestamp from which a published instrument version takes effect for gating purposes.
constraints: OPTIONAL per AO3_C2 — a version MAY carry one. Absence means IN EFFECT ON PUBLICATION, per the fail-closed derivation in REACCEPTANCE_R2.

IMMUTABLE once published, for the same reason reaccept_required is immutable: acceptances and refusals have already been evaluated against it, and moving it retroactively would silently change who was current when.

It is a property of the VERSION, never of an organization or a subject. There is no per-tenant effective_at, because AO3_C1 forbids a grace period applying across organizations and a per-tenant date is that grace period with a different name.
R2_EFFECTIVE_AT_SEMANTICS.interaction_with_reaccept_required: The two are INDEPENDENT fields and both are required for a version to refuse. effective_at answers WHEN the version applies; reaccept_required answers WHETHER applying it invalidates earlier acceptances. A version may be in effect and not require reacceptance — that is the ordinary case for a typo correction — and a version may require reacceptance and not yet be in effect.
R2_EFFECTIVE_AT_SEMANTICS.what_is_NOT_decided: The precision or timezone handling of the timestamp, and whether effective_at may be edited before publication as opposed to before effectiveness. Both are implementation choices no ratification constrains.

TWO_ACCEPTANCE_RELATIONS_NOT_ONE.ruling: Account-class and organization-class acceptances are stored in SEPARATE relations, not one polymorphic table with a nullable organization_id.
grounds: Their accepting principals are different KINDS - a natural person versus an organization - and a single table would need a nullable subject and a nullable organization with a check constraint asserting exactly one is present. That shape makes the most important invariant a constraint rather than a structure.

Their uniqueness rules differ: account acceptance is unique per (subject, version); organization acceptance is unique per (organization, version). One table cannot express both without partial indexes that are easy to get subtly wrong.
Their RLS profiles differ: an account acceptance is the subject own row; an organization acceptance is tenant-scoped data about the organization. Merging them merges two access-control problems.
MULTIORG_INTERSECTION.hard_separation in the CommercialAccount authority makes the same kind of separation for the same kind of reason: two questions that sound similar are not one question.
TWO_ACCEPTANCE_RELATIONS_NOT_ONE.cost_accepted: Two relations mean two write paths and two currency predicates. That duplication is accepted deliberately in exchange for each relation having exactly one accepting principal and one uniqueness rule.

WHAT_AN_ACCEPTANCE_ROW_MEANS.positive_claim: At accepted_at, this subject performed an affirmative act indicating assent to the exact bytes identified by this content identity, being version V of instrument_key K.
explicitly_NOT_claimed: It does not claim the subject read the text.
It does not claim the act is legally effective, enforceable, or sufficient for any obligation. That is CQ-06 and LEGAL_REVIEW_FLAGS.LRF-01.
It does not claim the instrument text is adequate, lawful, or reviewed.
WHAT_AN_ACCEPTANCE_ROW_MEANS.why_this_matters_in_an_authority: An acceptance table invites the reading that its rows prove consent. They prove a recorded act. FORBIDDEN_CLAIMS below prohibits the stronger reading being made on the basis of this artifact.

APPEND_ONLY.ruling: Both acceptance relations are APPEND-ONLY. No UPDATE of any column. No DELETE.
grounds: An acceptance is evidence of a past act, and evidence that can be edited is not evidence. This is the same reasoning the repository already applies to its audit and evidence surfaces.
Reacceptance ADDS a row for the newer version. It never overwrites the older one - so the history of what a subject accepted and when is fully reconstructible.
A withdrawal - if the owner ever defines one - would also be a new row of a different kind, never a deletion.
APPEND_ONLY.the_tension_that_must_be_recorded: Append-only acceptance evidence about a natural person interacts with erasure obligations, and LC0 HPO-LC0-03 is an open decision about exactly that tension for a different append-only surface (stella_interactions.response_json). This artifact does NOT resolve it and must not be read as having chosen retention over erasure. See OPEN_FINDINGS.F-AO-09 and LEGAL_REVIEW_FLAGS.LRF-04.

CONTENT_IDENTITY_IS_SNAPSHOTTED_ONTO_THE.ruling: Each acceptance row stores the content identity itself, not only a foreign key to the version row.
CONTENT_IDENTITY_IS_SNAPSHOTTED_ONTO_THE.why_the_FK_alone_is_insufficient: The FK is correct only while the version row is immutable and present. Storing the digest on the acceptance makes the acceptance self-describing: it survives any future reorganisation of the version relation, and it makes tampering with a version row DETECTABLE by comparison rather than silently authoritative.
CONTENT_IDENTITY_IS_SNAPSHOTTED_ONTO_THE.invariant: At write time, the snapshotted identity MUST equal the referenced version identity. The two must be written in one transaction and the equality must be enforced, not assumed.
CONTENT_IDENTITY_IS_SNAPSHOTTED_ONTO_THE.cost_accepted: The same fact is stored twice. This is the same deliberate trade the CommercialAccount authority makes in ORGANIZATION_RELATION.cost_accepted, and it carries the same obligation: one governed writer, never two.

WHO_MAY_WRITE_AN_ACCEPTANCE.account_class: Only the subject, for themselves. No administrator, no platform role, and no support path may create an account-class acceptance on another subject behalf. Grounds: HPO-A decision 1 is account-level, and A1_ACCOUNT_ACCEPTANCE_IS_IDENTICAL_ON_BOTH_JOURNEYS.
WHO_MAY_WRITE_AN_ACCEPTANCE.organization_class: Only a subject holding an ACTIVE organization_admin membership in the target organization, at the moment of the write, re-verified at the database boundary and never taken from a client-supplied role. Grounds: HPO-A decision 3, plus ratification MO-05 requirement that membership be revalidated on every request.
WHO_MAY_WRITE_AN_ACCEPTANCE.platform_admin: NOT AUTHORIZED to accept on a customer behalf by this artifact. A platform operator accepting a commercial instrument for a customer is a materially different act with a materially different evidentiary value, and HPO-A does not authorize it. If the owner wants an assisted/negotiated path, it needs its own decision. Recorded as OPEN_FINDINGS.F-AO-07.
WHO_MAY_WRITE_AN_ACCEPTANCE.superadmin_bypass_note: db/identity-context.ts:217 contains a measured super-admin exception to the membership check, which ratification MO-07 records as CONTRADICTS_PRODUCT_INTENT. That exception must NOT become an implicit acceptance-writing capability. See SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.X-AO-06.

R2_WHO_MAY_WRITE_AN_ACCEPTANCE_RATIFIED.status: R1 clause is CONFIRMED by ratification and TIGHTENED in one respect.
R2_WHO_MAY_WRITE_AN_ACCEPTANCE_RATIFIED.account_class_unchanged: Only the subject, for themselves. RAT-AO-01 and RAT-AO-02 both concern the ORGANIZATION-class act and neither touches this. R1 A1 ruling stands: HPO-A.1 is account-level and grants no delegation.

organization_class_now_RATIFIED_not_mere.before: R1 derived the requirement — an active organization_admin, re-verified at the database boundary — from HPO-A.3 plus ratification MO-05.
organization_class_now_RATIFIED_not_mere.after: RAT-AO-02 AO2_C2 states it as owner policy: performed ONLY by an ACTIVE organization_admin of the affected organization. The word ACTIVE is ratified text, not a derivation.

platform_admin_now_RATIFIED_prohibition.after: RAT-AO-02 AO2_C1 forbids it as owner policy, and canonical explicit_non_authorizations forbids building such a tool now or as a future convenience. R2_WHO_MAY_WRITE_AN_ACCEPTANCE_RATIFIED.manual_commercial_activation_is_not_acce: ADDED AT R2.
