T1_legal_instruments.purpose: The continuing identity of an instrument, independent of any edition.
invariants: I-T1-1: instrument_key is immutable once created and is never reused for a different instrument.
I-T1-2: instrument_class is fixed at creation and NEVER changes. An instrument that changed class would move the gate a subject must pass mid-journey.
I-T1-3: instrument_class is constrained to a closed two-value set. A third value requires new owner policy, not a schema migration.
I-T1-4: append-only. No UPDATE, no DELETE.
T1_legal_instruments.collapse_alternative_recorded: This relation could be collapsed into T2 by carrying instrument_key and instrument_class on every version row. That is a legitimate normalization choice and this artifact does not forbid it, PROVIDED I-T1-2 survives - which under the collapsed shape requires a constraint asserting that all versions of one key share one class. The separate relation makes the invariant structural; the collapsed shape makes it a constraint. Either is acceptable; silently having neither is not.

T2_legal_instrument_versions.purpose: One immutable published edition of an instrument, content-addressed.
conceptual_columns: instrument_key - FK to T1, NOT NULL
version - NOT NULL, totally ordered within instrument_key
content_digest_algorithm - NOT NULL, recorded not assumed

content_bytes or an immutable content reference - OPTIONAL. RECOMMENDED_NOT_REQUIRED, never NOT NULL from this authority perspective. Retaining the bytes lets the platform PRODUCE the accepted document rather than only prove a candidate matches; whether it must be able to is a legal/privacy/retention question sitting with LRF-01 and LRF-04, both COUNSEL_REQUIRED. See INSTRUMENT_MODEL.INSTRUMENT_IDENTITY_TUPLE.content_identity.CONTENT_RETENTION_SHAPE.
reaccept_required - boolean NOT NULL, NO DEFAULT
effective_at - OPTIONAL per RAT-AO-03 AO3_C2; NULL means IN EFFECT ON PUBLICATION (fail-closed derivation, see REACCEPTANCE.R2_CORRECTION_EFFECTIVE_AT)
published_by - the platform principal that published it, NOT NULL
invariants: I-T2-1: UNIQUE (instrument_key, version, locale). One edition per key per version per locale.

I-T2-2: APPEND-ONLY. No UPDATE of any column, no DELETE. A correction is a new version. This is the invariant the entire model rests on: an editable version row would let a published document be swapped under acceptances that already reference it.
I-T2-3: reaccept_required is NOT NULL with NO DEFAULT. See INSTRUMENT_MODEL.reaccept_required.why_no_default. A defaulting flag is the fail-open shape Packet B X-B-03 forbids.

I-T2-4 (AMENDED AT R3 — NO LONGER A REQUIREMENT): content_digest and content_digest_algorithm are REQUIRED and are written with the version row. Retention of the content bytes, or of an immutable reference to them, is RECOMMENDED_NOT_REQUIRED / IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE and is NOT an invariant of this authority. WHERE an implementation DOES retain them, they MUST be written in the SAME transaction as the digest — a digest whose bytes were written separately could be committed without them. That conditional is the whole of what survives; the R1/R2 form made retention itself mandatory and is WITHDRAWN. A conforming implementation retaining only the canonical digest evidence satisfies I-T2-4 vacuously and MUST NOT be rejected. This invariant MUST NOT be used as an exit-gate requirement for byte retention.

I-T2-5: the version ordering within an instrument_key must be a genuine TOTAL order, because the currency predicate searches an interval of it. A partial or ambiguous order makes the predicate ill-defined rather than merely awkward.
I-T2-6: publication writes the audit row in the same transaction.

I-T2-7: RLS enabled. The relation is PLATFORM-GLOBAL reference data, not tenant data: every subject must be able to READ the instrument they are being asked to accept, and NO tenant role may write. The read/write asymmetry is the whole access-control content of this table.

I-T2-8 (R2): effective_at is OPTIONAL, IMMUTABLE once published, and is a property of the VERSION only. There is NO per-organization, per-subject or per-tenant effective_at, deferral or waiver — that would be the grace period RAT-AO-03 AO3_C1 forbids, re-expressed as data. Authority X-AO-16.

I-T2-9 (R2): effective_at and reaccept_required are INDEPENDENT and BOTH are required for a version to refuse. effective_at answers WHEN the version applies; reaccept_required answers WHETHER applying it invalidates earlier acceptances. Authority RAT-AO-03 AO3_C4.
explicitly_not_decided: whether content_bytes is inline text or an immutable external reference
which platform principal may publish - governed by the platform-roles lineage, not here

WHETHER content bytes are retained at all — that is RECOMMENDED_NOT_REQUIRED and belongs to whichever authority answers LRF-01 and LRF-04. No retention duration, storage medium or reproduction obligation is chosen here.

T3_account_legal_acceptances.purpose: Evidence that one subject assented to one instrument version.
conceptual_columns: user_id - FK to users, NOT NULL
instrument_version_id - FK to T2, NOT NULL
invariants: I-T3-1: UNIQUE (user_id, instrument_version_id). A subject accepts a given version at most once. A second identical acceptance is a no-op, not a new fact.
I-T3-2: APPEND-ONLY. No UPDATE, no DELETE. Reacceptance adds a row for the newer version and never touches the older.
I-T3-3: NO is_current COLUMN AND NO is_valid COLUMN. Currency is COMPUTED from the row set plus T2. See REACCEPTANCE.PRIOR_ACCEPTANCES_ARE_NEVER_DELETED_OR_INVALIDATED_IN_PLACE.
I-T3-4: content_digest MUST EQUAL the referenced T2 row content_digest at write time, enforced not assumed. This is what makes tampering with a T2 row DETECTABLE rather than silently authoritative.
I-T3-5: the referenced instrument must be instrument_class ACCOUNT. An organization-class instrument must not be acceptable here.

I-T3-6: WRITABLE ONLY BY THE SUBJECT, FOR THEMSELVES. The write predicate is the subject own id, in the shape the repository already uses for self-scoped writes - the users_insert_own policy pattern whose WITH CHECK is id = auth.uid(), cited by Packet B PRE_VERIFICATION_WRITE_EXCEPTION.EXACT_PERMITTED_WRITE_SURFACE. No administrator, platform role or support path may write another subject row.

I-T3-7: NOT tenant data. It carries no organization_id and MUST NOT acquire one. A subject accepts before they belong to any organization - in J-FOUNDER they demonstrably belong to none - so an organization column would be NULL at exactly the moment it mattered and would invite a fabricated value.
I-T3-8: RLS enabled and FORCED. Read restricted to the subject themselves plus whatever platform read path the platform-roles lineage authorizes - which this artifact does not name.
I-T3-9: NO identifying metadata beyond user_id is mandated. No ip_address, no user_agent, no device fingerprint. See LEGAL_REVIEW_FLAGS.LRF-03.

T4_organization_commercial_acceptances.purpose: Evidence that one organization, through an authorized administrator, assented to one instrument version.
conceptual_columns: organization_id - FK to organizations, NOT NULL
instrument_version_id - FK to T2, NOT NULL
accepted_by_user_id - FK to users, NOT NULL
accepted_by_role - NOT NULL, the role held AT ACCEPT TIME
invariants: I-T4-1: UNIQUE (organization_id, instrument_version_id). Organization-level, not member-level. A second administrator accepting the same version adds no new fact. See MULTI_ORG.the_CommercialAccount_trap for what this uniqueness is NOT.
I-T4-2: APPEND-ONLY. No UPDATE, no DELETE.
I-T4-3: NO is_current COLUMN. Currency is computed, as in I-T3-3.
I-T4-4: content_digest MUST EQUAL the referenced T2 digest at write time.
I-T4-5: the referenced instrument must be instrument_class ORGANIZATION.

I-T4-6: accepted_by_user_id MUST hold an ACTIVE organization_admin membership in organization_id AT WRITE TIME, re-verified at the database boundary in the same transaction and NEVER taken from a client-supplied role. Grounds: HPO-A decision 3 plus ratification MO-05 per-request revalidation.

I-T4-7: accepted_by_role IS RECORDED AND IS NOT DERIVED FROM CURRENT MEMBERSHIP. The role is the authority for the act and is not reconstructible later - the accepting admin may have changed role or left. See ADJUDICATION_FOUNDER_VS_INVITED.A5.

I-T4-8: NO commercial_account_id column and NO CommercialAccount-level uniqueness. Acceptance is scoped to the ORGANIZATION. A CommercialAccount governing several organizations must not confer a passing L1 on an organization that never accepted. Grounds: HPO-A decision 2, plus ratification CA-08 which already establishes that CommercialAccount aggregation creates no implicit shared authorization.
I-T4-9: IS tenant data. RLS enabled and FORCED, scoped by organization membership in the shape the repository already uses.

I-T4-10: writing this row grants NOTHING. It creates no entitlement, changes no membership, changes no organizations.status and mutates no CommercialAccount. See ATOMICITY_BOUNDARIES.AB-3.must_not_contain and ratification CA-03.

CROSS_RELATION_INVARIANTS: I-X-1: NO relation carries a stored currency flag. The predicate is computed at read time from T2, T3 and T4. A stored flag would require a system-wide UPDATE on every marked publication, contradicting append-only and creating partial-failure states.
I-X-2: NO acceptance relation is polymorphic over subject and organization. Two relations, two accepting principals, two uniqueness rules. See ACCEPTANCE_MODEL.TWO_ACCEPTANCE_RELATIONS_NOT_ONE.

I-X-3: NO acceptance relation is reachable by a DELETE from any application path. Retention and erasure of acceptance evidence is an OPEN question - LC0 HPO-LC0-03 adjacency - and no erasure path is authorized here.

I-X-4: NO existing table is repurposed. In particular db/schema.ts:148 invitations.acceptedAt is NOT extended, aliased, or read as acceptance evidence, and db/schema.ts:130 audit_logs.ipAddress is not the acceptance metadata carrier.

I-X-5: NO column is added to organizations, users, organization_members or commercial_accounts to denormalize acceptance state. A cached acceptance boolean on organizations would be the same correctness error as I-X-1 with a wider blast radius.
WHAT_THIS_SECTION_DELIBERATELY_DOES_NOT_: The entitlement/bootstrap-state substrate that HPO-A decision 6 requires the bootstrap to write atomically. It does not exist - measured, grep -i entitlement across db/schema.ts returns two COMMENTS and no object - and it belongs to the CommercialAccount/Entitlement lineage, not here. This artifact defines the ACCEPTANCE that gates entitlement; it does not define entitlement.

The composed bootstrap definer that AB-2 requires. It is a database-authority allocation and COMMERCIAL_ACCOUNT_ENTITLEMENT_AUTHORITY cap05_reconciliation already claims it as a required successor whose identifier and lineage are a future allocation.
commercial_account_organization_history, which the CommercialAccount authority specifies and which does not exist. Named here only to record that AB-2 must include its open row if it lands.
Any change to the single-active-membership index. See MULTI_ORG.WHAT_DECISION_8_DOES_NOT_AUTHORIZE.
Any RLS policy text. Postures are stated as invariants; policies are the database lineage to write.

PACKET_A_PRESERVATION.claim: For any subject who is current on every published account-class instrument, the observable Packet A routing behaviour after L0 is IDENTICAL to its behaviour without L0.
PACKET_A_PRESERVATION.why_structurally_credible: L0 is a PREFIX, not a rewrite. It returns control to R1 through R5 untouched when the predicate passes, and it never reads, writes or clears the selected-organization carrier, never enumerates memberships, and never changes a Packet A destination.
PACKET_A_PRESERVATION.how_it_must_be_PROVEN_rather_than_assert: The Packet A control scenarios - zero candidates, exactly one candidate, two or more candidates, stale carrier, super-admin, and RETURN SITE 3 - must be re-driven with a subject who is CURRENT on account instruments, and must produce the SAME destinations Packet A requires. See TEST_MANIFEST P-AO-9 through P-AO-13.

THE_FIXTURE_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_COMPOU.packet_b_precedent: Packet B R3_ADDITION_THE_PRESERVATION_PROOF_HAS_A_PREREQUISITE records that the Packet A controls live in tests/auth/route-authorization-boundary.test.ts and drive Packet A through SIX RequestPrincipal literals the file constructs itself, at :136-140, :146-151, :157-162, :166-171, :174-179 and :559-563. Packet B extends RequestPrincipal with a verification flag, so those six fixtures MUST be repinned as VERIFIED or every Packet A control silently becomes a control about an unverified subject - GREEN, and meaningless.
THE_FIXTURE_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_COMPOU.how_L0_compounds_it: L0 extends RequestPrincipal a SECOND time. The same six fixtures must ALSO be repinned as ACCEPTANCE-CURRENT. If they are not, every Packet A control becomes a control about an unaccepted subject: the suite stays GREEN because the subjects are refused at L0 before reaching R1..R5, and the preservation proof proves nothing.
THE_FIXTURE_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_COMPOU.the_requirement: The acceptance flag on RequestPrincipal MUST NOT be optional-with-a-permissive-default, for exactly the reason Packet B gives: a defaulting flag masks this class of omission and is itself the fail-open shape X-B-03 forbids. Every fixture must state its acceptance state EXPLICITLY.
THE_FIXTURE_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_COMPOU.the_line_anchors_are_re_measurement_obli: Those six anchors were measured by Packet B at ITS AS_OF_HEAD 38dde646, not at this one, and Packet B implementation will itself edit that file. The implementing mission MUST re-measure them and MUST NOT replay these numbers.
THE_FIXTURE_TRAP_IS_INHERITED_AND_COMPOU.control: M-AO-9 - a fixture left at the permissive default must turn a Packet A preservation control RED.

PACKET_A_PRESERVATION.the_specific_regression_this_guards: An implementer who places L0 AFTER Packet A R2 rather than before would leave enumeration running for unaccepted subjects. That change is invisible in the accepted path - every positive control still passes - and is caught only by an assertion that NO enumeration occurs on the refusal path. See N-AO-5.

The enforcement topology C3/C4/C5/C6 and the C7 DEFENSE_IN_DEPTH reclassification. L0 attaches to the same points as K3/K4/K5/K6 and adds NO new point.

LEGAL_REVIEW.governing_decision: HPO-A decision 9 - qualified legal review remains mandatory for actual legal instruments and release sufficiency.

THE_DISTINCTION_THAT_MUST_NEVER_BE_COLLA.rule: OWNER RATIFICATION IS NOT LEGAL REVIEW. HPO-A is a product-owner decision about what the platform will build. It is not, and must not be represented as, legal advice, counsel review, counsel sign-off, or a determination that anything is legally sufficient.
THE_DISTINCTION_THAT_MUST_NEVER_BE_COLLA.why_this_rule_is_stated_first: This artifact contains an owner decision (HPO-A) and a legal subject matter (instruments and acceptance) in one document. That combination is exactly where the two get conflated - a reader sees an owner-ratified decision about legal instruments and reads it as legal approval of them. Every flag below exists to make the conflation impossible to perform accidentally.
THE_DISTINCTION_THAT_MUST_NEVER_BE_COLLA.the_symmetric_prohibition: It is equally wrong to represent this artifact as establishing that anything is NOT legally sufficient. It records repository state, an owner decision, and open questions. It establishes neither compliance nor breach. This mirrors LC0 note_on_negative_claims, which is carried here deliberately.

LEGAL_REVIEW.WHAT_HPO_A_IS: A product-owner decision about the SHAPE of a mechanism: which instruments the platform will record acceptance of, from whom, and with what version binding. It is authority over ENGINEERING SCOPE.
WHAT_HPO_A_IS_NOT: It is NOT a determination that the mechanism satisfies any legal or regulatory obligation.
It is NOT approval of any instrument TEXT. No instrument text was authored, reviewed, or read for legal content in this lane.
It is NOT a finding that account-level acceptance, organization-level acceptance, or the combination is sufficient for anything.
It is NOT a substitute for CQ-06, which remains open with counsel.

FLAGS.question: Is the acceptance evidence defined by ACCEPTANCE_MODEL sufficient to establish assent, and does organization-level acceptance by an administrator bind that organization individual users?
FLAGS.carried_from: LC0 COUNSEL_CHECKPOINT_1 CQ-06, verbatim in substance
FLAGS.why_HPO_A_does_not_answer_it: HPO-A decides WHAT is captured. Sufficiency is a legal interpretation of what is captured. The two are different questions and the second is not the owner to answer.
FLAGS.what_this_artifact_did_instead: Designed the model so that the answer, whichever it is, does not require re-engineering: every subject accepts the account-class instruments personally, so the individual-user question is narrowed to the commercial instrument alone.
FLAGS.MUST_NOT_BE_REPRESENTED_AS: Answered, mitigated, or reduced to a low risk by the design choice above. Narrowing a question is not answering it.

FLAGS.question: Which locale of an instrument binds the signer, given that the repository ships two language surfaces per instrument - app/(public)/terms and /terminos, /privacy and /privacidad - with different line counts and no declaration that they are translations of one text?
FLAGS.status: OPEN - COUNSEL REQUIRED, and also an owner decision on product scope
FLAGS.measured_basis: Four pages measured at 182, 173, 164 and 155 lines. No version marker in any of them.
FLAGS.why_this_artifact_does_not_decide_it: It is a legal question about which text a person is bound by, and HPO-A is silent.
FLAGS.what_this_artifact_did_instead: Required T2 to carry a locale and required the acceptance to bind the SPECIFIC LOCALIZED VERSION the subject was shown. That is fail-closed under either eventual answer: binding the shown text is correct whether or not another locale is also authoritative.
FLAGS.residual_risk_recorded: If counsel determines that one locale is authoritative and another is informational only, acceptances bound to the informational locale may need a governed remediation. The design makes that remediation POSSIBLE - the locale is recorded - but does not prevent the situation.

FLAGS.question: What identifying metadata may or must be captured alongside an acceptance - IP address, user agent, timestamp precision, device information - and is capturing it lawful, necessary, and proportionate?
FLAGS.why_it_is_a_legal_question_in_both_direc: Such metadata strengthens evidentiary value AND is itself personal data whose collection needs a basis. The pressure runs both ways, which is precisely why an engineer should not choose.
FLAGS.what_this_artifact_DID: MANDATED NONE. Invariant I-T3-9 states that no identifying metadata beyond user_id is required. The acceptance model is complete and functional without any of it.
FLAGS.measured_adjacency: db/schema.ts:130 declares audit_logs.ipAddress varchar(45), so the repository already has a place where an IP is recorded for other verbs. Its existence must NOT be read as a decision that acceptance rows should carry one.
FLAGS.prohibition: An implementing mission MUST NOT add such a column on its own initiative. It requires this flag answered plus an owner decision.

FLAGS.question: How does append-only acceptance evidence about a natural person interact with erasure and data-subject-rights obligations?
FLAGS.adjacency: LC0 HPO-LC0-04 is discharged by this artifact, but LC0 HPO-LC0-03 - reconciling irreversible retention with erasure obligations - is OPEN and concerns the same tension for a different append-only surface. The options LC0 enumerates there without recommendation are structurally the same options that would apply here.
FLAGS.what_this_artifact_DID: Chose APPEND-ONLY, because evidence that can be edited is not evidence, and recorded that choice as UNRESOLVED against erasure rather than as settled. Invariant I-X-3 authorizes NO erasure path, which preserves the owner and counsel freedom to define one.
FLAGS.MUST_NOT_BE_REPRESENTED_AS: A decision that acceptance evidence is exempt from erasure, or that retention has been justified. It has not been.
FLAGS.explicitly_not_claimed: This artifact does not assert that Uellix supports, or does not support, the right to erasure. LC0 FORBIDDEN_COMPLIANCE_CLAIMS prohibits the positive claim and note_on_negative_claims prohibits the negative one.

FLAGS.question: Is the RELEASE SUFFICIENT - that is, may Uellix onboard commercial customers once this mechanism exists and instruments are published?
FLAGS.status: OPEN - COUNSEL REQUIRED. THIS IS THE FLAG MOST LIKELY TO BE MISREAD.
FLAGS.the_misreading_to_prevent: That implementing this artifact lifts LC0 commercial_activation and self_service_onboarding gates. IT DOES NOT. Those gates lift on THREE independent events: (1) the substrate exists, (2) real instruments are published into it, (3) counsel has answered sufficiency. This artifact addresses only the DEFINITION of (1). It does not build it, does not populate it, and cannot perform (3).
FLAGS.governing_decision: HPO-A decision 9 names release sufficiency explicitly as requiring qualified legal review.

SECURITY_REVIEW.status: DESIGN-LEVEL ONLY. No penetration test, no PostgreSQL probe, no live environment observation. Every prohibition below is derived from measured code plus frozen authority.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT capture any acceptance before B0 is satisfied.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: Packet B PRE_VERIFICATION_WRITE_EXCEPTION.WHAT_IT_MUST_NOT_BE_ABLE_TO_CREATE lists, verbatim, any commercial acceptance record. Frozen authority already forbids it.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.the_concrete_shape_this_forbids: A Terms checkbox on the signup form. It is the most natural product instinct and it is forbidden: it records assent by a party whose control of the address is unproven, which is worse than no evidence because it looks like evidence.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT treat any existing timestamp, flag or column as acceptance evidence.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: HPO-A decision 4 requires instrument_key, version and content identity. None of those carries any of the three.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT derive a content identity by rendering a page, hashing a component file, or hashing a build output at acceptance time.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: INSTRUMENT_MODEL.INSTRUMENT_OF_RECORD_VERSUS_PRESENTATION. A JSX page rendered text is a function of the build and changes silently; an acceptance bound to it names an unrecoverable document.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT make the act of discharging L1 depend on any entitled capability.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: NO_DEADLOCK_PROOF.the_one_residual_cycle_risk. L1 gates entitlement; if discharging L1 required an entitlement, the graph would deadlock and no organization could ever be activated.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.note: Making the act of INVITING entitlement-dependent is NOT prohibited and is not a deadlock - the founder can still discharge L1 themselves.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT write instrument TEXT into audit_logs before_json or after_json.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: AUDIT.THE_CONTENT_LEAK_PROHIBITION. Prior repository evidence records that those columns carry verbatim content in many verbs, and operator surfaces read them.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT let the super-admin membership-check exception become an acceptance-writing capability.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.measured_basis: db/identity-context.ts:217 reads if (identity.organizationId !== null && check.is_member !== true && !check.is_super_admin) before throwing DB_IDENTITY_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_MEMBER. The !check.is_super_admin clause is a present-day exception that ratification MO-07 records as CONTRADICTS_PRODUCT_INTENT.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.consequence: Without an explicit prohibition, an organization-class acceptance write reaching the database through that path would let a platform super-admin accept a commercial instrument on a customer behalf, silently, with the audit row attributing it to them. That is a materially different act from a customer accepting, and ACCEPTANCE_MODEL.WHO_MAY_WRITE_AN_ACCEPTANCE does not authorize it.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.requirement: I-T4-6 active organization_admin membership check must be enforced INDEPENDENTLY of the super-admin bit, not as a branch that the bit can satisfy.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.note: This artifact does NOT fix db/identity-context.ts:217. Closing that bypass is MO-07 REQUIRED_RESOLUTION and needs its own governed authority. This prohibition prevents the acceptance model from DEPENDING on it being open.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT mutate any state on a GET request in the invitation journey, including terminal state transitions.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: HPO-A decision 7, and the measured defect at app/invite/accept/page.tsx:53 plus lib/invitations/service.ts:175-178.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT convert a failure to read acceptance state into a pass.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: FC_6. A try/catch whose catch branch returns a permissive value defeats the entire model and is invisible in every positive test.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT record acceptance at CommercialAccount level, nor let a CommercialAccount confer a passing L1 on an organization that has not accepted.
MUST NOT enumerate memberships, disclose organization existence, or reveal tenancy shape on any acceptance refusal path.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: Packet A NO_AUTO_SELECTION and Packet B B3 prohibitions, carried into FC_1.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT express the L1 accepting-role check as a hierarchy threshold, and MUST NOT include super_admin in its role set.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: RAT-AO-01 AO1_C6, RAT-AO-02 AO2_C2, and the corroborating RAT-OP-01 which excludes hasRole('>='), role-hierarchy and '+' notation by name.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.measured_why: hasRole is ROLE_HIERARCHY[user] >= ROLE_HIERARCHY[required] at lib/auth/permissions.ts:24-26; super_admin is 100 and organization_admin is 80 at lib/auth/roles.ts:38-44, so hasRole('super_admin','organization_admin') is TRUE; and db/schema.ts:113 permits super_admin as an organization_members.role value. The idiomatic check therefore admits a tenant super_admin membership.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.the_required_form: EXACT EQUALITY on organization_admin over an ACTIVE membership in the affected organization, re-verified at the database boundary, never taken from a client-supplied value.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT treat any commercial state as acceptance evidence, and MUST NOT let any commercial state bypass L0 or L1.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.named_target: ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE (HPO-B.7) and any other manual commercial activation state.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: RAT-AO-02 AO2_C3 — manual commercial activation under HPO-B does not substitute for legal or commercial acceptance.

This is therefore a FORWARD prohibition, and its absence today must not be read as evidence that a bypass exists.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT provide any platform-admin, support, operator, commercial-team or back-office mechanism that records or satisfies an organization acceptance, and MUST NOT let a support capability confer acceptance authority.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: RAT-AO-02 AO2_C1 and AO2_C2, reconciled with RAT-OP-01 in PLATFORM_ADMIN_BOUNDARY. The positive clause AO2_C2 excludes every actor who is not an active organization_admin, whether or not that actor appears in any negative enumeration.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.relationship_to_X_AO_06: X-AO-06 forbade the super-admin membership-check exception becoming an acceptance-writing capability and was DERIVED at R1. X-AO-13 is the broader, RATIFIED prohibition. X-AO-06 is retained and upgraded to ratified standing rather than absorbed, because it names a specific measured code site and X-AO-13 does not.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT infer, require, design or assert an automatic notification side effect of an acceptance refusal or of an acceptance becoming due, and NO control may depend on one.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: RAT-AO-01 says the organization_admin RECEIVES the completion CTA. It does not say the system SENDS anything. Receiving an affordance on a governed surface is not being sent a message, and the ratification stops where it stops.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.why_an_explicit_prohibition_is_needed: A blocked member plus an unaware admin is an obviously bad product outcome whose obvious fix is an email. Inventing it here would create an async-delivery obligation belonging to the HPO-C lineage, governed separately by RAT-ASY-01, and would attribute to the owner a decision they did not make.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT refuse at L0 or L1 on the basis of a version whose effective_at has not yet arrived, and MUST NOT treat display, dismissal or acknowledgement of a pre-effective notice as an acceptance.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: RAT-AO-03 AO3_C3 and AO3_C4. Before effective_at the product may inform and is not required to block; from effective_at the gate applies.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.the_two_opposite_errors_this_forbids: Refusing early converts a notice window into an outage. Treating a dismissed notice as acceptance manufactures evidence of an act that never occurred. Both are failures of the same clause in opposite directions.

SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.prohibition: MUST NOT introduce a per-organization, per-subject or per-tenant effective_at, deferral, waiver or exemption.
SECURITY_PROHIBITIONS.grounds: RAT-AO-03 AO3_C1 forbids a grace period applying across all versions or all organizations; a per-tenant date or waiver is that grace period re-expressed as data. effective_at is a property of the VERSION only.

SECURITY_PROPERTIES_CLAIMED.non_duplicative: One derivation on the principal path, one propagation onto RequestPrincipal, and translations only into vocabularies the boundaries already speak. The count of translations is fixed by the codebase existing refusal vocabularies, not by the number of places the policy is restated.
SECURITY_PROPERTIES_CLAIMED.no_new_privilege: The model grants nothing. An acceptance row creates no entitlement, no membership, no role and no authorization. Ratifications CA-03 and CA-05 are preserved.
SECURITY_PROPERTIES_CLAIMED.no_new_tenant_surface: Account-class acceptances are not tenant data and carry no organization_id. Organization-class acceptances are tenant data scoped exactly as existing tenant relations are.

That the audit_logs insert policy admits a NULL organization_id row from the acceptance path. See OPEN_FINDINGS.F-AO-15.

CITATION_RESOLUTION_R3.why_this_section_exists: R2 added CLAUSE_ID_RESOLUTION for the AOn_Cm ids because short citations are PREFIXES of descriptive declaration keys, so an exact-match checker reports false danglings. The same hazard applies to SECTION-PATH citations used throughout this artifact — FUTURE_DDL.T2, ATOMICITY_BOUNDARIES.AB-4, FAIL_CLOSED.FC_7, LEGAL_REVIEW.FLAGS.LRF-02 and others. Each cites a real object under a key that is longer than the citation. Without an explicit convention an auditor gets false danglings in both directions and cannot tell a citation error from a naming convention.
CITATION_RESOLUTION_R3.RESOLUTION_RULE: A section-path citation of the form PARENT.SHORT resolves to the UNIQUE key under PARENT that either equals SHORT or begins with SHORT followed by an underscore. Where that rule yields exactly one key the citation is RESOLVED; where it yields zero or more than one, the citation is DANGLING or AMBIGUOUS and is a defect.
CITATION_RESOLUTION_R3.determinism_requirement: The rule must yield EXACTLY ONE key. The index below materializes every short-form section citation used in this artifact together with the full key it resolves to, so that exact-match resolution is possible without applying the prefix rule at all.

ARRAY_HOSTED_IDS.convention: Ids carried in ARRAY elements are addressed by their id FIELD, not by an object key, so the prefix hazard does not arise for them. They resolve by scanning the named array for an element whose id equals the citation exactly.

arrays.ATOMICITY_BOUNDARIES.AB-n: ATOMICITY_BOUNDARIES.boundaries[] element with id === "AB-n" (ids AB-1..AB-5, exact match)
arrays.LEGAL_REVIEW.FLAGS.LRF-n: LEGAL_REVIEW.FLAGS[] element with id === "LRF-n" (ids LRF-01..LRF-05, exact match)
arrays.BLOCKING_DEPENDENCIES.BD-n: BLOCKING_DEPENDENCIES.items[] element with id === "BD-n" (ids BD-1..BD-6, exact match)

ARRAY_HOSTED_IDS.note: Only OBJECT-KEY citations need the prefix rule and the index above. The two classes are distinguished here so an auditor does not apply the prefix rule where exact match already works, nor exact match where the prefix rule is needed.
